# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the interactive companion book for **MathCamp 2026**, the math camp
for the incoming Political Science PhD cohort. It replaces last year's
slide-based sessions (archived in `Resources/Slide Decks 2025/`) with
interactive, web-based material built in Quarto.

## How to use this book

Each chapter corresponds to a lecture session and includes worked examples,
practice problems, and interactive visualizations (via `plotly`, `Shiny`, or
similar R tooling) to build intuition alongside the math. Every session is
available in two forms:

- **Webpage** (this book) — the full written version, with more detail and
  worked examples.
- **[Slides](slides/index.html)** — a slideshow version for in-class use.

## Sessions

1. Notation, Functions, and Limits
2. Probability
3. Calculus I: Differentiation & Optimization
4. Calculus II: Integration & Multivariate Calculus
5. Linear Algebra
